defects.title: Workspace symlinked-parent escape: bounded read/write could reach outside the workspace
defects.found_by: supplied offline suite (test_symlink_parent_denied failed on this kernel)
defects.detail: workspace.py delegated symlink refusal to a single O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW open. On this gVisor 4.19 kernel that open does not return ELOOP for a symlinked directory, so it followed the link. Reads of files outside the workspace succeeded and an approved write would have landed outside it.
defects.fix: Refusal is now enforced in code rather than delegated to one kernel flag. Each path component is lstat-checked, then opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, then confirmed to be the same (st_dev, st_ino) as the lstat reported. The root descriptor is inode-verified too, and read() re-checks the final component.
defects.verified: All 5 new tests fail against the original file and pass against the repaired one.

defects.title: private_dir accepted a symlinked leaf directory and chmod'd the link target
defects.found_by: automated source review, then confirmed by direct execution
defects.detail: private_dir pre-checked is_symlink() and then called Path.mkdir(exist_ok=True). That call swallows the error for an existing symlink-to-directory because its fallback is_dir() resolves the link, and the following chmod-by-path follows it as well. The pre-check was therefore the only guard, and it is not atomic. private_dir gates the application home, palace, runtime, cards, exports, identity-history and the workspace root.
defects.fix: After mkdir, the directory is opened and the descriptor is compared against lstat by (st_dev, st_ino); permissions are applied with fchmod through that descriptor instead of by path.
defects.verified: The evaded-pre-check test fails against the original file and passes against the repaired one. The link target's mode is asserted unchanged.
defects.scope_note: Symlinked ANCESTORS remain allowed on purpose, and a test pins that: macOS /tmp and /var are symlinks, so refusing ancestors would break the target host. Only the leaf is constrained.

reviewed_not_defects.item: Journal.finish() has no WHERE state='applying' guard, unlike reject().
reviewed_not_defects.conclusion: Not a defect today. Its only caller goes through claim(), which does BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus a pending-state check in one transaction, so single-use approval holds. Left unchanged rather than edited for appearance.
reviewed_not_defects.action: Recorded here so a future second caller is not added without re-checking.
